items.t: ARMOUR Residential REIT (ARR) Stock Looks Rich Against Its Book Value
items.sum: ARMOUR Residential REIT has seen a tough share-price run in recent years, which puts a spotlight on what investors are really paying for today. With the market pricing shifting around it, the open question is how closely the current US$10.83 share price lines up with the trust's book value. items.t: 4 High-Yield Mortgage REITs Facing a Growing Dividend Cut Risk
items.sum: Yields above 18% look like a gift, but a surging Treasury rate is squeezing book values and stretching leverage across mortgage REITs. One test shows which payouts hold up, and one name already left shareholders with a buyout.
